exercises.title: Slide check: SPA routing with react-router-dom v6
exercises.problemHtml:
Twelve questions on Slot 14: client vs server routing, setting up react-router-dom v6, declaring routes, nested routes with Outlet, params, optional params and navigation hooks.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mười hai câu về Slot 14: định tuyến phía client và server, cài react-router-dom v6, khai báo route, route lồng với Outlet, tham số, tham số tuỳ chọn và hook điều hướng.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: SPA routing with react-router-dom v6 — answer key

1. In a single-page application, changing the URL…
   Answer: b) is handled in the browser by the router, which swaps components without a full reload
   The server sends index.html once; the router maps URLs to components. / Server gửi index.html một lần; router ánh xạ URL sang component.

2. Install command for the web router?
   Answer: b) npm i react-router-dom
   react-router-dom includes the DOM bindings (BrowserRouter, Link…). / react-router-dom có phần cho DOM (BrowserRouter, Link…).

3. Where is <BrowserRouter> usually placed?
   Answer: b) Once, around the whole app (index.js)
   Everything using router hooks must be inside it. / Mọi thứ dùng hook của router phải nằm bên trong nó.

4. v6 replaced <Switch> with…
   Answer: a) <Routes>
   And component={X} became element={}. / Và component={X} thành element={}.

5. Which path matches every URL not matched by other routes?
   Answer: b) *
   Use it for a Not Found page. / Dùng cho trang Not Found.

6. Read :id from /products/:id:
   Answer: a) useParams()
   const { id } = useParams(); — a string. / const { id } = useParams(); — là chuỗi.

7. What renders the matching child route inside a parent layout?
   Answer: a) <Outlet />
   Nested routes render into the parent's Outlet. / Route lồng vẽ vào Outlet của cha.

8. An index route…
   Answer: a) renders when the URL exactly matches the parent path
   } /> / } />

9. Navigate to /login after logout (in an event handler):
   Answer: a) const navigate = useNavigate(); navigate("/login")
   useHistory is v5; window.location reloads the whole app. / useHistory là v5; window.location tải lại cả app.

10. /users/:id? means…
   Answer: b) the id segment is optional (v6.5+)
   Both /users and /users/3 match. / Cả /users lẫn /users/3 đều khớp.

11. Advantages of NavLink over Link? (choose all)
   Answer: a) Adds an active class/state when its path matches + b) Accepts className/style functions with { isActive } + d) Supports end to match exactly
   Otherwise it is a Link. / Ngoài ra nó giống hệt Link.

12. Why split routes into separate files per feature?
   Answer: b) Each feature owns its routes, App only composes them — easier to maintain large apps
   Exercise 20: decoupling routes. / Exercise 20: tách route.
